fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: a pounce deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Pounce and Let Go
fusions.desc: You pounce on a target up to 6 tiles away with a raking weapon strike for 11 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You move 30% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Stare-Down
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds, and slips you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: A Life to Spare
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
